description: This file implements a certificate path builder for SSL/TLS certificate validation, including path traversal, issuer selection, trust evaluation, and path verification logic.

classes.name: IssuerEntry
classes.description: Represents a certificate and its trust level, used during issuer selection.

classes.name: CertIssuersIter
classes.description: Iterates through potential issuer certificates from sources, supporting synchronous and asynchronous retrieval, and prioritization.

classes.name: CertIssuerIterPath
classes.description: Tracks the current path of certificates to prevent duplicates and cycles during path building.

classes.name: CertPathBuilderResultPath
classes.description: Represents a constructed certificate path with trust info and validation status.

classes.name: CertPathIter
classes.description: Generates possible certificate paths from a target to a trust anchor, exploring issuer chains.

classes.name: CertPathBuilder
classes.description: Main class orchestrating the certificate path building and validation process.

methods.name: FingerPrintParsedCertificate
methods.description: Computes a hex-encoded SHA-256 fingerprint of a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: CertDebugString
methods.description: Generates a debug string for a certificate, including fingerprint and subject.

methods.name: PathDebugString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of a list of certificates for debugging.

methods.name: CalculateKeyIdentifierMatch
methods.description: Determines if the authority key identifier matches the subject key identifier between issuer and target certificates.

methods.name: TrustAndKeyIdentifierMatchToOrder
methods.description: Assigns a priority order to issuer certificates based on trust level and key identifier matching.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::GetNextIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the next candidate issuer certificate, handling sync and async sources.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::AddIssuers
methods.description: Adds new issuer certificates to the iteration, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::DoAsyncIssuerQuery
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous issuer queries from sources.

methods.name: CertIssuersIter::SortRemainingIssuers
methods.description: Sorts remaining issuer candidates based on prioritization rules.

methods.name: CertPathIter::GetNextPath
methods.description: Generates the next possible certificate path, exploring issuer chains and handling limits.

methods.name: CertPathBuilder::Run
methods.description: Executes the path building process, verifying paths, and returning the best or all valid paths.
